strategy.offer: Certified natural cosmetics and wellness products for face, body, and specialized skin needs, including vegan options, trial sizes, gift items, and professional-use products.

strategy.resources: Its basis is know-how, long-term supplier relationships, high-quality sustainable ingredients, and integrated in-house capabilities from development and production to order handling and shipping.
strategy.direction: It is moving toward more sustainable packaging, continued product innovation, and more open, transparent production.
